column3: Develop Python applications and APIs using Python, Django, Flask, SQL and REST APIs. Experience with software development and backend programming is required.
Analyze business data using Python, pandas, SQL, Excel and data visualization. Knowledge of statistics and reporting is preferred.
Build and deploy machine learning models using Python, scikit-learn, pandas and NumPy. Experience with model evaluation and data preprocessing is required.
Build responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Experience with frontend development and UI design is preferred.
Develop scalable backend services using Python, Java or Node.js. Knowledge of databases, APIs, authentication and server-side programming is required.
Work with large datasets and develop predictive models using Python, machine learning, statistics, pandas and scikit-learn.
Create visual designs, social media graphics and marketing materials using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and graphic design principles.
Manage cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. Experience with Docker, Linux, Git and cloud platforms is required.
Monitor security systems, identify vulnerabilities and investigate security incidents. Knowledge of networking, security tools and threat analysis is preferred.
Design, develop, test and maintain software applications. Experience with programming, databases, APIs and software development practices is required.
Develop artificial intelligence applications using Python, machine learning, natural language processing and deep learning techniques.
Design and maintain databases, write complex SQL queries and optimize database performance. Experience with relational databases is required.
